identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Tides Center' in San Francisco, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 94-3213100), matching the agenda's 'The Tides Center' and 'San Francisco, CA'
Tides Center's own website says it provides HR and payroll services, consistent with OUSD's Talent/Human Resources agreement for 'Staff & hiring'
research.notes: OUSD agreements are with 'The Tides Center (General)'. Tides Center is a separate legal entity from Tides Foundation (EIN 51-0198509) and Tides Network. General email and main phone not found on fetched pages.

profile.summary: Tides Center is a nonprofit based in San Francisco that acts as a fiscal sponsor. It lends its tax-exempt status and provides back-office help, such as accounting, grants management, and human resources and payroll services, to social change projects and organizations. It is part of the Tides network, together with Tides Foundation.

review.notes: Tides Center (EIN 94-3213100, San Francisco) matches the agenda name and city, and its HR, payroll and accounting back-office services fit the Talent/HR agreement. The 1012 Torney Ave address appears on the cited page only as the Tides Foundation grant-report address, and the contact page lists only P.O. boxes for Tides Center, so the address is dropped.
